hikes.name: Cowiche Canyon
hikes.blurb: An old rail bed through a basalt and andesite canyon west of Yakima, crossing the creek on bridges.

hikes.name: Umtanum Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: From Umtanum Falls Trailhead, a 1.8-mile round trip to Umtanum Creek Falls.

hikes.name: Baldy Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Mile Post 10 Water Access, a 4.5-mile round trip to the top of Baldy Mountain (3,231 ft), with about 2,000 feet of climbing.
